intro.title: OUR GUESTHOUSES
intro.p1: Marrakech Séminaire Maison D'Hôtes is pleased to present its various properties. Our numerous and diverse villas will allow you to find the one suited to your exclusive stay.
intro.p2: Whether you are looking for a villa for your wedding requiring 60 beds or for a family gathering of about fifteen guests, we have the villa suited to each of these events. Furthermore, if you wish, our on-site teams supervised by your event organizer, Nadia, will be there to assist you in organizing your seminars, your Arabian Nights wedding, your birthday or a product launch or a yoga retreat. We are capable of managing for you:
intro.s1: airport pickup with our trusted transport partners
intro.s2: oriental tastings prepared by our kitchen brigades
intro.s3: performances by our DJs, fire-eaters and folklore troupes for unforgettable evenings
intro.s4: Nadia will be your dedicated contact throughout your stay so you can fully enjoy your family, colleagues and friends.

about.p1: Listen carefully. Your next event does not need to be merely « decent ». It must be unforgettable.
about.p2: Picture this: your guests touch down in Marrakech, our teams handle their airport pickup, and they arrive at a villa designed specifically for your event, exclusively privatized. No more rushing around. No more managing everything. You enjoy.
about.p3: That is what we do. An Arabian Nights wedding where you need 60 beds? We have the villa. A family celebration for fifteen guests? We have the villa. A seminar, a birthday, a product launch, or a yoga retreat? We have the villa.
about.p4: And while you enjoy, Nadia, your event organizer, is your dedicated relay. Oriental tastings prepared by our culinary brigades, DJs, fire-eaters, and folklore groups for lively evenings: we manage it all.
about.p5: So ask yourself one single question: do you want to organize just another event, or the one your guests will remember for years to come?
about.p6: Do not let this date slip away. Request your quote today.

serviceDetail.whyUsText: Because with us, you have a single dedicated contact person and we take care of everything. We offer multiple luxury properties in Marrakech, ranging from 5 to 60 bedrooms, and handpick the ideal exclusive venue for your celebration. Our experienced on-site team is personally supervised by Nadia, your dedicated event coordinator, acting as your seamless liaison throughout your stay.
offers: Multiple private estates at your disposal: luxury villas, authentic riads, and boutique guesthouses from 5 to 60 bedrooms
A dedicated on-site professional team, led by Nadia, your primary event planner
Airport meet-and-greet with our trusted premium transport partners
Authentic Moroccan cuisine and oriental gourmet tastings crafted by our private in-house chefs
Special dietary requirements and allergies accommodated: please specify them in your request
Lively evening entertainment: live DJs, fire-eaters, and traditional folklore performers for vibrant nights
Signature Marrakech excursions: Agafay desert dinners, quad biking, and 4x4 Atlas mountain expeditions
